title: The Flashback Lantern
learning_focus: Story grammar; flashback plot; main idea; intransitive verbs; noun/pronoun/adjective complements; narrative text; order of adverbs; visual purpose and contribution.
story_premise: A lantern in the regional archive shows the ending of a celebration before its beginning. The Pathfinder must enter its memories, identify the flashback structure, and restore the present-day story.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Story grammar; flashback plot; main idea; intransitive verbs; noun/pronoun/adjective complements; narrative text; order of adverbs; visual purpose and contribution.

areas.title: Present-Day Plaza
areas.story: Identify the current characters, setting, conflict, and visual purpose. Recognize the signal that begins a flashback and distinguish past memory from current action.
